title: Let's Celebrate
subtitle: Celebrations · Simple past: regular and irregular verbs

p: Pessoas do mundo todo têm celebrations (celebrações) e festivals (festivais). Elas lembram o passado, encontram a família e os amigos, comem e se divertem.
Palavras de festa: a costume (fantasia), a mask (máscara), a party (festa), a feast (banquete), a lantern (lanterna), fireworks (fogos de artifício), decorations (enfeites) e a parade (desfile).

p: Numa festa de aniversário aparecem: a present (presente), a birthday cake (bolo de aniversário), candles (velas), an invitation (convite) e balloons (balões).

Pistas do livro: You write this on paper. You give it to your friends. → an invitation. They are usually round. They have air inside. → balloons. They are long and thin. You put them on a birthday cake. → candles.

scenes.alt: Crianças reunidas ao redor de um bolo de aniversário, com balões e enfeites.

p: Para contar o que aconteceu, usamos o simple past. Nos verbos regulares, acrescentamos -ed no final: watch → watched, play → played, listen → listened, celebrate → celebrated.
Se o verbo já termina em e, colocamos só -d: dance → danced, like → liked.
Pergunta e resposta longa: Did you watch the parade? → Yes, we watched the parade. / Did you like the music? → Yes, we liked it a lot!
Atenção: na pergunta com Did o verbo fica normal (Did you watch…?); na resposta longa ele vai para o passado (We watched…).

grammar: Já termina em e: acrescente só -d.
Já termina em e: acrescente só -d.

p: Alguns verbos não ganham -ed: eles mudam de forma no passado. São os verbos irregulares, e precisamos memorizá-los.
go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, sing → sang, drink → drank, wear → wore, have → had, write → wrote, give → gave, take → took.
Exemplos do livro: Did you go to the parade? → Yes, I went to the parade. / Did you see the fireworks? → Yes, I saw the fireworks. / Did you eat cake at the party? → Yes, I ate a piece of cake.

p: O texto compara duas celebrações. No Day of the Dead (Dia dos Mortos), no México, as famílias lembram pessoas queridas que morreram. O livro destaca 1º de novembro; as tradições acontecem entre o fim de outubro e o início de novembro e variam entre comunidades.

Flores, velas, alimentos e retratos podem fazer parte das homenagens. O livro descreve famílias levando um banquete (a big feast) ao cemitério. As caveiras decoradas fazem parte da celebração e da memória; não representam uma festa de terror.

O Yi Peng, na Tailândia, também acontece em novembro. Tem desfile, fantasias bonitas e milhares de lanternas de papel de arroz que sobem ao céu. As pessoas acreditam que as lanternas levam embora as coisas ruins. No último dia há fogos de artifício.
Na escrita do Hiro, The Sapporo Snow Festival, ele usa o passado: I went… I wore a snowsuit… We saw snow sculptures… We played… We listened, ate and drank…

Treino de leitura: In Mexico, families remember relatives who died during the Day of the Dead. They share a feast at the cemetery and light candles. Some give candy skulls. At Yi Peng in Thailand, people watch paper lanterns rise into the sky. They believe the lanterns take away bad things.

games.title: Questions and long answers
games.instructions: Escolha a resposta completa para cada pergunta. Todas as pistas indicam que a ação aconteceu.
pairs: Did they play games at the party? ✅
Yes, they played games at the party.
Did he dance at the festival? ✅
Yes, he danced at the festival.
Did he take a present to the party? ✅
Yes, he took a present to the party.

quiz.q: Ouça a palavra e escolha o significado.
quiz.explain: Parade é desfile. Convite é invitation, fantasia é costume e banquete é feast.

quiz.q: “They are long and thin. You put them on a birthday cake.” What are they?
quiz.explain: Candles (velas) são compridas e finas e vão em cima do bolo de aniversário.

quiz.q: Qual é o passado do verbo watch?
quiz.explain: Watch é regular: ganha -ed e vira watched.

quiz.q: Qual é o passado do verbo go?
quiz.explain: Go é irregular: no passado vira went. Exemplo: I went to the parade.

quiz.q: Did you see the fireworks? Escolha a resposta longa correta.
quiz.explain: See é irregular. No passado vira saw: Yes, I saw the fireworks.

quiz.q: Did you eat cake at the party? Escolha a resposta correta.
options: Yes, I ate a piece of cake.
Yes, I eated a piece of cake.
Yes, I eat a piece of cake.
Yes, I eaten a piece of cake.
quiz.explain: Eat é irregular: o passado é ate.

quiz.q: Complete: “Yesterday I ______ in my favorite costume. I was a superhero!”
quiz.explain: Yesterday mostra que é passado. Dress é regular: dress up vira dressed up.
Sing vira sang no passado (muda de forma). Os outros ganham -ed: played, danced, listened.

quiz.q: Ouça e escolha o passado do verbo que você ouviu.
quiz.explain: Você ouviu drink (beber). No passado ele vira drank.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. Where do families share a feast during the Day of the Dead?
quiz.explain: O texto localiza o banquete no cemitério: at the cemetery.
quiz.context: In Mexico, families remember relatives who died during the Day of the Dead. They share a feast at the cemetery and light candles. Some give candy skulls. At Yi Peng in Thailand, people watch paper lanterns rise into the sky. They believe the lanterns take away bad things.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. Who do families remember during the Day of the Dead?
quiz.explain: A primeira frase informa que as famílias lembram parentes que morreram: relatives who died.
quiz.context: In Mexico, families remember relatives who died during the Day of the Dead. They share a feast at the cemetery and light candles. Some give candy skulls. At Yi Peng in Thailand, people watch paper lanterns rise into the sky. They believe the lanterns take away bad things.

quiz.q: Leia o texto. What rises into the sky at Yi Peng?
quiz.explain: O texto diz que as lanternas de papel sobem ao céu: paper lanterns rise into the sky.
quiz.context: In Mexico, families remember relatives who died during the Day of the Dead. They share a feast at the cemetery and light candles. Some give candy skulls. At Yi Peng in Thailand, people watch paper lanterns rise into the sky. They believe the lanterns take away bad things.

quiz.q: Escreva o passado do verbo play.
quiz.explain: Play é regular: play + ed = played. Exemplo: After dinner all the children played games.

quiz.q: Did they watch the parade? ✅ Escolha a resposta completa.
quiz.explain: Na pergunta, Did acompanha watch. Na resposta afirmativa, watch vira watched.

quiz.q: Complete a resposta com a frase inteira: “Did you play games?” ✅ Comece com “Yes, I…” e use play games.
quiz.explain: Play é regular: a resposta completa é Yes, I played games.

quiz.q: Responda com a frase inteira: “Did she dance at the party?” ✅ Comece com “Yes, she…” e use dance at the party.
answers: Yes, she danced at the party.
quiz.explain: Dance já termina em e; acrescentamos d: Yes, she danced at the party.

quiz.q: Responda com a frase inteira: “Did he go to the festival?” ✅ Comece com “Yes, he…” e use go to the festival.
answers: Yes, he went to the festival.
quiz.explain: Go muda para went na resposta afirmativa: Yes, he went to the festival.

quiz.q: Ouça o relato. What did Ana see at the festival?
options: She saw stars in a planetarium.
quiz.explain: Ana diz I saw fireworks. Ela também conta que dançou e comeu bolo.
quiz.listen: Yesterday I went to a festival with my family. I danced and ate cake. At night, I saw fireworks. It was exciting!

quiz.q: Complete a pergunta: “______ she ______ a costume at the party?”
quiz.explain: A pergunta usa Did + pessoa + verbo na forma base: Did she wear a costume?
